title: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program Enrollment and Tier Placement Rules
content:
A Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program (CGM program) is opened when Larkfield accepts a referral for this product line. The tier written on the program is fixed by the coverage the program bills, never by the customer's preference.

## 1. Locating the tier

1.1 The tier is located from the coverage record named on the program: the coverage record's plan type and coverage order must equal the tier's entry gate, and the self-pay tier is used only when no coverage record is named.

1.2 The coverage record named on the program must be in effect on the date of the write: its effective date is on or before that date and its termination date is empty or on or after that date.

1.3 A customer with an in-effect Original Medicare Part B coverage record cannot be enrolled on the self-pay tier for an item Medicare covers, because Larkfield submits a claim for every Medicare-covered item it supplies to a Medicare beneficiary; that customer is enrolled on the CGM Original Medicare Program, and an item or quantity Medicare will not pay is handled under the program's liability notice rule.

1.4 When a customer has two in-effect coverage records, the one whose coverage order is primary fixes the tier, and the secondary coverage only receives crossover or secondary claims; a coverage record whose coverage order is secondary never fixes the tier.

1.5 Any clinical qualification in the tier's entry gate is read from the program's own clinical fields as documented on the prescriber's written order and medical records, never from the customer's description alone.

## 2. Entry gates

| Tier | Coverage the gate requires | Qualifying insulin regimens | Further gate condition |
|---|---|---|---|
| CGM Self-Pay Program | No coverage named | Multiple daily injections; insulin pump; basal insulin only; non-insulin with problematic hypoglycemia; non-insulin | A written order is required |
| CGM Commercial HMO Program | Commercial HMO, primary | Multiple daily injections; insulin pump | A network referral is required |
| CGM Commercial PPO Program | Commercial PPO, primary | Multiple daily injections; insulin pump; basal insulin only | None |
| CGM Medicare Advantage Program | Medicare Advantage, primary | Multiple daily injections; insulin pump; basal insulin only; non-insulin with problematic hypoglycemia | None |
| CGM Original Medicare Program | Medicare Part B, primary | Multiple daily injections; insulin pump; basal insulin only; non-insulin with problematic hypoglycemia | None |
| CGM Medicaid Program | Medicaid, primary | Multiple daily injections; insulin pump | None |

## 3. Program changes

3.1 A program change rewrites the coverage reference and the tier together when the customer's insurance changes, and rewrites prescriber or product fields when a newer written order changes them.

3.2 A change never rewrites status, and after a tier change the next refill may draw only on an authorization grant recorded under the new tier.

3.3 A coverage the customer reports that is not on file cannot be written onto a program, because coverage records are created only by Larkfield's benefits verification team after the payer confirms eligibility. The coverage-in-effect test of 1.2 and the entry-gate match of 1.1 apply to a program change as they do to an enrollment.

## 4. Applying the rules (hypothetical cases)

| Situation on the date of the write | Result |
|---|---|
| A primary commercial PPO coverage record, effective last year, termination date empty | The CGM Commercial PPO Program, the record being in effect |
| The same record with a termination date equal to the date of the write | Still in effect: a termination date on the date of the write satisfies 1.2 |
| The same record with a termination date the day before the write | Not in effect; it cannot be named on the program |
| A primary Medicaid record and a secondary commercial HMO record, both in effect | The CGM Medicaid Program; the secondary record never fixes the tier |
| No coverage record named, and no in-effect Medicare Part B record | The CGM Self-Pay Program |
| A coverage the customer describes that has no coverage record on file | Nothing is written onto the program |
